name: PRIMES and composites
description: Every integer, minted once as an NFT on TON. Composites prove their factorization, primes pass Miller-Rabin on chain, and every claim the game makes is a public get-method you can check yourself at https://primes.live/verify. The core loop is strictly sequential: a head pointer walks the unsold composites, and the one at the head mints for a flat 1 GRAM against a submitted prime factorization. A number ahead of the head can be taken early at an ascending auction, which mints it off-head and makes the head skip that position forever; a prime at its turn opens a descending lot from its own opening price and rests there until someone buys it, which mints it in the same transaction. Owning a prime pays you tribute forever: every composite minted from it thereafter routes a share to its factors. Every number is minted exactly once and never again.
